Hi Lena — thanks for sending this over. Below are our answers for the hosted API; I’ve also attached a short regional dataflow diagram and our SOC 2 summary extract for audit purposes.

Quick summary up front:
- Primary request/response payloads can be pinned to a region (US, EU, APAC) at customer onboarding. For your account we can pin to us-east-1.
- Default retention: ephemeral request cache (seconds to minutes), request logs/metadata retained 30 days by default, immutable backups retained up to 90 days. Audit logs kept 365 days.
- Deletion SLO: logical deletion/purge of live indices within 72 hours of a verified request; backups and geo-replicated snapshots are subject to a staged purge window and are eligible for physical deletion within 90 days; we provide purge evidence and job run logs.

Full answers (matching your spreadsheet numbering):
1) Data residency: For hosted API customers we offer region pinning for storage and compute. When you select US (us-east-1), primary payloads and derived artifacts (tokens, embeddings, model inputs) are stored in that region. Logs and metrics used for platform ops can be routed to the same region on request; otherwise they default to our centralized telemetry plane which we can scope by account.

2) Retention windows:
- Live request/response artifacts: default 30 days (configurable at onboarding).
- Ephemeral caches/KV: kept in-memory and evicted quickly; not persisted beyond the request lifecycle unless caching is explicitly enabled.
- Audit logs (access, role changes, API key events): 365 days.
- Backups / snapshots: rolling daily snapshots retained for 90 days by default; point-in-time restores supported within that window.

3) Deletion process and SLOs:
- Customer-initiated erasure: request via the support portal (or an emailed signed DSR). We verify the request, then schedule a logical purge of live indices and customer-owned artifacts.
- SLO: 72 hours for logical purge from live systems.
- Physical deletion: For backups/snapshots, deletion is staged to ensure consistency across replicas — the targeted data is flagged and excluded from future restores, and full physical deletion completes within the default backup window (up to 90 days). We provide an attestation of completion and job logs when available.
- Edge cases (regulatory holds, legal requests): preserved only with explicit customer instruction; we surface required impacts and timelines before proceeding.

4) Evidence and auditables:
- We can provide: purge job logs, snapshot deletion records, retention configuration screenshots, and an SOC 2 summary.
- Enclosed: redwood-dataflow-region.pdf (diagram showing region pinning and snapshot flow) and redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (summary extract). If you need raw job logs we can deliver a redacted bundle in the evidence ZIP.

Next steps:
